model.status: DRAFT. A temporary model made for the PoC. Not decided. Not agreed with the data owner, the provider or the City's technical custodian. Not submitted to Smart Data Models. Not proposed as a general model.
model.definition: A modelled result for one sewer overflow chamber and one modelled day: inflow, overflow, level, the period, where the values come from and under which agreement they were delivered.
model.definition_sv: Ett modellerat resultat för en bräddbrunn och ett modellerat dygn: tillrinning, bräddning, nivå, perioden, varifrån värdena kommer och under vilket avtal de levererades.

profiles.A: All terms, including location and sourceSrs. Non-public.
profiles.B: All terms except location and sourceSrs. Public.

model.weirDefinition: A sewer overflow chamber (brunn) as recorded in the data owner's register.
model.weirDefinition_sv: En bräddbrunn som den står i dataägarens register.

terms.name: SewerOverflowModelResult
terms.definition: A modelled result for one sewer overflow chamber and one modelled day: inflow, overflow, level, the period, where the values come from and under which agreement they were delivered.
terms.definition_sv: Ett modellerat resultat för en bräddbrunn och ett modellerat dygn: tillrinning, bräddning, nivå, perioden, varifrån värdena kommer och under vilket avtal de levererades.

terms.name: SewerOverflowWeir
terms.definition: A sewer overflow chamber (brunn) as recorded in the data owner's register.
terms.definition_sv: En bräddbrunn som den står i dataägarens register.

links.comment: INSPIRE sewer appurtenance 'discharge structure'. A possible broader term; to be decided with the data owner.

terms.name: SewerOverflowModelA
terms.definition: The entity type under which Distribution A (profile A, all terms including the position of the chamber, non-public) is stored in the City's platform. A profile of SewerOverflowModelResult, not a different model.
terms.definition_sv: Entitetstypen som Distribution A (profil A, alla termer inklusive brunnens position, ej offentlig) lagras under i stadens plattform. En profil av SewerOverflowModelResult, inte en annan modell.

terms.name: SewerOverflowModelB
terms.definition: The entity type under which Distribution B (profile B, all terms except the position of the chamber, open data) is stored in the City's platform. A profile of SewerOverflowModelResult, not a different model.
terms.definition_sv: Entitetstypen som Distribution B (profil B, alla termer utom brunnens position, öppna data) lagras under i stadens plattform. En profil av SewerOverflowModelResult, inte en annan modell.

terms.name: inflowMeanM3S
terms.definition: Mean inflow rate to the chamber over the modelled day.
terms.definition_sv: Medeltillrinning till brunnen under det modellerade dygnet.

links.comment: Raw-water open-channel junction; same quantity, different domain. Not equal.

terms.name: inflowPeakM3S
terms.definition: Highest modelled inflow rate to the chamber during the modelled day.
terms.definition_sv: Högsta modellerade tillrinning till brunnen under dygnet.

links.comment: As inflowMeanM3S.

terms.name: inflowVolumeM3
terms.definition: Total volume that flowed into the chamber during the modelled day (sum of inflow rate times time step).
terms.definition_sv: Total volym som rann in i brunnen under dygnet.

links.comment: Smart Data Models OpenChannelManagement: water inflow. Close in meaning; the unit and the period differ.

terms.name: overflowVolumeM3
terms.definition: Total volume that overflowed from the chamber during the modelled day.
terms.definition_sv: Total volym som bräddade ur brunnen under dygnet.

links.comment: Volume (cubic metre) discharged into water, defined for stormwater and treatment plant discharges. Related, not equal.

terms.name: overflowPeakM3S
terms.definition: Highest modelled overflow rate during the modelled day.
terms.definition_sv: Högsta modellerade bräddflöde under dygnet.

links.comment: Smart Data Models Environment (WaterObserved): water discharge. Close in meaning; ours is the modelled peak overflow.

terms.name: overflowDurationMin
terms.definition: Total time within the modelled day during which the modelled overflow rate was above zero (a sum, not the longest single episode).
terms.definition_sv: Total tid under dygnet då modellerat bräddflöde var större än noll (summa, inte längsta enskilda episod).
terms.note: Regulators report overflow duration (for example the English Event Duration Monitoring returns); no machine-readable vocabulary was found for it.

terms.name: waterLevelMaxM
terms.definition: Highest modelled water level in the chamber during the modelled day. The height reference is not specified in the source data.
terms.definition_sv: Högsta modellerade vattennivå i brunnen under dygnet. Höjdreferensen är inte angiven i källdatan.

links.comment: Current water level of an observation (in that subject: of a storage tank). Ours is a maximum over a day. Related, not equal.

terms.name: modelledDay
terms.definition: The calendar day (UTC) the result is modelled for.
terms.definition_sv: Det kalenderdygn (UTC) resultatet är modellerat för.

terms.name: periodStart
terms.definition: Start of the modelled period (ISO 8601, UTC).
terms.definition_sv: Början på den modellerade perioden (ISO 8601, UTC).

links.comment: Start of an observation period. Ours is a modelled period, not an observed one.

terms.name: periodEnd
terms.definition: End of the modelled period (ISO 8601, UTC). Also used as the observedAt time of the values.
terms.definition_sv: Slutet på den modellerade perioden (ISO 8601, UTC). Används också som observedAt för värdena.

links.comment: End of an observation period. Ours is a modelled period, not an observed one.

terms.name: dataSource
terms.definition: Where the values come from: measured (a full day of measurements), measured-partial (part of the day) or modelled-synthetic (a synthetic series, not data).
terms.definition_sv: Varifrån värdena kommer: measured, measured-partial eller modelled-synthetic (syntetisk serie, inte data).

terms.name: modelVersion
terms.definition: Name and version of the calculation model that produced the values.
terms.definition_sv: Namn och version på beräkningsmodellen som gav värdena.

terms.name: overflowStart
terms.definition: Start of the first time step with overflow in the modelled day. Absent when there was no overflow.
terms.definition_sv: Start på första tidssteget med bräddning under dygnet. Saknas om ingen bräddning skedde.

terms.name: overflowEnd
terms.definition: End of the last time step with overflow in the modelled day. Absent when there was no overflow. Overflow need not be continuous between start and end.
terms.definition_sv: Slut på sista tidssteget med bräddning. Saknas om ingen bräddning skedde. Bräddningen behöver inte vara sammanhängande.

terms.name: measuredCoverage
terms.definition: Share (0 to 1) of the day's time steps that rest on measured values. Only for chambers with a sensor.
terms.definition_sv: Andel (0 till 1) av dygnets tidssteg som vilar på mätvärden. Bara för brunnar med sensor.

terms.name: syntheticScale
terms.definition: Scale factor applied to a measured pattern to make a synthetic inflow series. Present only when dataSource is modelled-synthetic. PoC specific.
terms.definition_sv: Skalfaktor som gör en syntetisk tillrinning ur ett uppmätt mönster. Bara när dataSource är modelled-synthetic. Specifikt för PoC:en.

terms.name: syntheticOverflowScale
terms.definition: Scale factor applied to make a synthetic overflow series. Present only when dataSource is modelled-synthetic. PoC specific.
terms.definition_sv: Skalfaktor för syntetiskt bräddflöde. Bara när dataSource är modelled-synthetic. Specifikt för PoC:en.

terms.name: sampleCount
terms.definition: Number of time steps the day's aggregates are computed from.
terms.definition_sv: Antal tidssteg som dygnets aggregat är beräknade ur.

terms.name: refWeir
terms.definition: The chamber this result belongs to (identifier of a SewerOverflowWeir entity).
terms.definition_sv: Brunnen resultatet hör till (id för en SewerOverflowWeir-entitet).

terms.name: provenance
terms.definition: Where the delivery came from and under which agreement. A structured value; its members are the terms with the prefix provenance. below.
terms.definition_sv: Varifrån leveransen kom och under vilket avtal. Ett strukturerat värde; medlemmarna finns som termer med prefixet provenance. nedan.

terms.name: location
terms.definition: Position of the chamber (GeoJSON point, longitude and latitude). Only in the profile A.
terms.definition_sv: Brunnens position (GeoJSON-punkt, longitud och latitud). Bara i profil A.

links.comment: Core NGSI-LD term, reused as is.

terms.note: Profile B leaves it out. That is a decision about who may see the position, not a different model.

terms.name: sourceSrs
terms.definition: The coordinate reference system the source position was given in (for example EPSG:4619). Only in the profile A.
terms.definition_sv: Koordinatsystemet källans position anges i (till exempel EPSG:4619). Bara i profil A.

links.comment: The OGC address of the EPSG code used in the PoC data.

terms.name: name
terms.definition: Name of the chamber.
terms.definition_sv: Brunnens namn.

links.comment: Core NGSI-LD term, reused as is.

terms.note: In the provider's delivery this field is called weirName; the City's register entity calls it name. The draft uses name.

terms.name: weirId
terms.definition: The data owner's key for the chamber. The same key follows the chamber through the whole chain and ends the entity identifier.
terms.definition_sv: Dataägarens nyckel för brunnen. Samma nyckel följer brunnen genom hela kedjan och avslutar entitetens id.

terms.name: regionId
terms.definition: Identifier of the region (area) the chamber belongs to in the source register.
terms.definition_sv: Id för det område brunnen tillhör i källregistret.

terms.name: category
terms.definition: Classification of the chamber in the source register.
terms.definition_sv: Brunnens klassning i källregistret.

terms.name: weirType
terms.definition: Type of chamber or weir structure in the source register.
terms.definition_sv: Typ av brunn eller överfallskonstruktion i källregistret.

links.comment: INSPIRE sewer appurtenance 'discharge structure'. Possible broader term; to be decided with the data owner.

terms.name: seriesRef
terms.definition: Reference to the sensor series of the chamber in the source system, when there is one.
terms.definition_sv: Referens till brunnens sensorserie i källsystemet, när det finns en.

terms.name: outlet
terms.definition: The discharge point (outlet) the chamber overflows to.
terms.definition_sv: Utsläppspunkten (outlet) brunnen bräddar till.

terms.name: recipient
terms.definition: The receiving water body (recipient) of the discharge point.
terms.definition_sv: Recipienten (vattenförekomsten) utsläppspunkten leder till.

terms.name: source
terms.definition: Where the chamber's record comes from: the name of the data owner's register file it was read from.
terms.definition_sv: Varifrån brunnens uppgifter kommer: namnet på dataägarens registerfil som de lästes ur.

links.comment: Dublin Core: a related resource from which the described resource is derived.

terms.name: dataProvider
terms.definition: The party that supplied the chamber's record to the data space (the provider).
terms.definition_sv: Den part som levererade brunnens uppgifter till dataspacet (leverantören).

links.comment: Dublin Core: the entity responsible for making the resource available.

terms.name: description
terms.definition: A free-text description of the chamber from the data owner's register.
terms.definition_sv: En fri beskrivning av brunnen ur dataägarens register.

links.comment: Dublin Core: an account of the resource.

terms.name: provenance.contractAgreementId
terms.definition: Identifier of the contract agreement under which the data was delivered (provider side).
terms.definition_sv: Id för avtalet leveransen skedde under.

terms.name: provenance.contractAgreementUrl
terms.definition: Address of the agreement in the City's agreement register.
terms.definition_sv: Adress till avtalet i stadens avtalsregister.

terms.name: provenance.dataset
terms.definition: Name of the data product.
terms.definition_sv: Dataproduktens namn.

links.comment: Title of a dataset.

terms.name: provenance.distribution
terms.definition: Distribution of the data product: A (full) or B (open).
terms.definition_sv: Dataproduktens distribution: A (full) eller B (öppen).

terms.name: provenance.distributionId
terms.definition: Identifier of the distribution in the catalogue.
terms.definition_sv: Distributionens id i katalogen.

terms.name: provenance.batchId
terms.definition: Identifier of the delivery batch.
terms.definition_sv: Id för leveransbatchen.

terms.name: provenance.producedAt
terms.definition: Time the values were produced (ISO 8601, UTC).
terms.definition_sv: Tidpunkt då värdena producerades.

links.comment: PROV-O generatedAtTime.

terms.name: provenance.ingestedAt
terms.definition: Time the City's platform received the delivery (ISO 8601, UTC).
terms.definition_sv: Tidpunkt då stadens plattform tog emot leveransen.

terms.name: provenance.accessRights
terms.definition: Whether the distribution is public or non-public.
terms.definition_sv: Om distributionen är publik eller icke-publik.

links.comment: Dublin Core accessRights.

terms.name: provenance.informationClass
terms.definition: The information class of the distribution (for example K0R1T1 or K1R1T1).
terms.definition_sv: Distributionens informationsklass (till exempel K0R1T1 eller K1R1T1).

terms.name: provenance.license
terms.definition: The licence or agreement terms the distribution is offered under.
terms.definition_sv: Licensen eller avtalsvillkoren distributionen erbjuds under.

links.comment: Dublin Core license.

terms.name: provenance.publisher
terms.definition: The organisation that produced and published the data.
terms.definition_sv: Organisationen som producerade och publicerade datan.

links.comment: Dublin Core publisher.

terms.name: provenance.receivedVia
terms.definition: How the data reached the City's platform.
terms.definition_sv: Hur datan nådde stadens plattform.

terms.name: provenance.transferProcessId
terms.definition: Identifier of the transfer in the data space connector.
terms.definition_sv: Id för överföringen i dataspace-connectorn.
